$comment: Public-site wording for every Miles product. What is sold, its release status and whether it can be trialed come from the application registry and database/erp-products.json (registry.type + registry.code); an entry without a registry record is shown as coming soon. Features of a product that is not released describe what it is being built to do.

products.name: Pharmacy ERP
products.summary: Medicines, batches and expiry, the counter and prescriptions, with the books kept for you.
products.headline: Every medicine accounted for, from delivery to dispensing.
products.subhead: Batch and expiry tracking, a fast counter, prescriptions and a controlled-drugs register, with sales, stock and cash posted straight to Miles Finance.
products.audience: Retail pharmacies, medical stores and pharmaceutical wholesalers, from one branch to many.
products.seoTitle: Pharmacy ERP with batch and expiry tracking
products.seoDescription: Pharmacy software with batch and expiry tracking, expiry-first selling, prescriptions, a controlled-drugs register and tills, with accounting built in.

features.title: Medicines catalogue
features.body: Generic and brand names, strength, form, barcode and storage condition. Flag prescription-only and controlled items; sell packs or units at their own price.

features.title: Batches and expiry
features.body: Every batch carries its number, expiry date and cost. The counter sells the batch that expires first and blocks anything expired.

features.title: Quarantine and recalls
features.body: Put a batch on hold in one step. Quarantined stock can be released; recalled stock never sells.

features.title: A fast counter
features.body: Search or scan, apply approved discounts, take cash, mobile money or card, and print an 80 mm receipt.

features.title: Prescriptions
features.body: Record prescriptions, have a pharmacist verify them, and dispense part of one when stock is short.

features.title: Controlled drugs register
features.body: Every movement of a controlled item, logged and ready for inspection.

features.title: Tills and cash-up
features.body: Each cashier opens a till and counts it at closing; any over or short is posted to Finance.

features.title: Purchasing and stock
features.body: Purchase orders, goods received onto a shelf or fridge, supplier returns, branch transfers and second-person disposals.

features.title: Reports
features.body: Stock, near-expiry, sales, profitability, purchases and cashier reconciliation, all exportable to CSV.

workflow.title: Receive
workflow.body: Goods arrive against a purchase order, by batch and expiry, and the supplier bill appears in Finance.

workflow.title: Sell and dispense
workflow.body: The counter picks the batch that expires first and checks prescriptions before dispensing.

workflow.title: Close the day
workflow.body: Tills are counted and revenue, cost of goods and cash are already in the ledger.

faqs.question: Does it work for several branches?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each branch has its own stock, locations and tills, with transfers between branches and reports per branch.

faqs.question: Is accounting included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pharmacy ERP includes Miles Finance, and every sale, purchase, return and write-off posts to it automatically.

products.seoTitle: Retail ERP: POS, wholesale and stock
products.seoDescription: Retail and wholesale software with barcode checkout, credit customers, price lists, quotations to invoices, stock and reports on one set of books.

features.title: Products and barcodes
features.body: Barcodes, categories, unit prices, packs and reorder levels, with optional expiry tracking.

features.title: Fast checkout
features.body: Scan to add, take cash, mobile money or card, print receipts, and handle voids and returns.

features.title: Customers on credit
features.body: Credit limits enforced at the sale, customer payments, and statements that match Finance.

features.title: Wholesale documents
features.body: Price lists, quotations, sales orders, delivery notes and invoices, with partial deliveries.

features.title: Purchasing and stock
features.body: Purchase orders, receiving, supplier returns, branch transfers and approved write-offs.

features.title: Reports
features.body: Sales by product, category, cashier and branch, margins, slow movers and a reorder list.

workflow.title: Stock up
workflow.body: Order from suppliers and receive deliveries into stock, with the bill in Finance.

workflow.title: Sell
workflow.body: Walk-in sales at the barcode counter; trade customers buy on account from a price list.

workflow.title: Collect
workflow.body: Customer payments clear their statements, and every amount is already in the books.

faqs.question: Can I sell on credit?
faqs.answer: Yes. Give a customer a credit limit; a sale on account over the limit is refused.

faqs.question: Can a pharmacy also run a shop?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pharmacy and Retail run side by side in one workspace and share one set of books, and each reports on its own.

products.name: Miles Finance
products.summary: Double-entry accounting with bank reconciliation, tax, budgets and fixed assets.
products.headline: Accounting your accountant will trust.
products.subhead: A double-entry ledger with periods, bank reconciliation, tax, budgets and fixed assets, fed automatically by every Miles ERP or used on its own.
products.audience: Businesses that want proper books, the accountants who serve them, and every Miles ERP customer.
products.seoTitle: Miles Finance: accounting with bank reconciliation
products.seoDescription: Accounting software with a double-entry ledger, bank reconciliation, tax returns, budgets, fixed assets and multi-currency.

features.title: The ledger
features.body: Chart of accounts and journals that always balance; corrections are reversals, so the audit trail stays whole.

features.title: Sales and purchases
features.body: Invoices and receipts, bills and supplier payments, credits and returns.

features.title: Bank reconciliation
features.body: Import statements as CSV, accept suggested matches, save rules and reconcile to the statement balance.

features.title: Month-end and year-end
features.body: Lock months in order, close the year into retained earnings and set opening balances.

features.title: Tax
features.body: Tax codes, a return for any period, filing that locks the period, and the settlement journal.

features.title: Multi-currency
features.body: Foreign-currency accounts, invoices and payments, daily rates and month-end revaluation.

features.title: Budgets and fixed assets
features.body: Budget against actuals, and an asset register with monthly depreciation.

features.title: Reports
features.body: Trial balance, profit and loss, balance sheet, aged receivables and payables, and cash flow.

workflow.title: Record
workflow.body: Sales and purchases arrive from your Miles ERP, or are entered in Finance.

workflow.title: Reconcile
workflow.body: Match the bank statement and lock the month.

workflow.title: Report
workflow.body: Run the statements and file the tax return from the same ledger.

faqs.question: Can I use Finance without an ERP?
faqs.answer: Yes. Miles Finance works on its own, and connects automatically if you add an ERP later.

faqs.question: Can I bring my opening balances?
faqs.answer: Yes. Opening balances are set when you start, so the books carry on from where you are.
